Financial and MNPI. The dataset contains the company's complete financial history: audited financial statements from 1997 through 2018; monthly balance sheets and P&L statements from January 2017 through February 2024 for Innovation Industries, Innovation Aviation, and 125 Ricefield; board meeting packages with notes from 2012 through August 2026 (current year); subsidiary valuations including VCI working capital and valuation analysis; CARES Act PPP loan documents; 20+ years of accounts payable records (46 GB across 180-550+ vendor folders per year); bank reconciliation files for 8 separate bank accounts; and payroll budget worksheets.
